note: v459: With more than one bank connected, you can now tag a record with which bank it's Paid from — on an unmatched 'in your books' row, tap Paid from and pick the bank. That record then only shows when you reconcile that bank, so records from one account stop cluttering another's statement. Untagged records still match any bank (nothing changes until you tag something), and single-bank users see no change. Tagged records stay findable — and re-taggable — under 'Find any record'. New profiles.recon_bank column (run the migration; the app works before you do).
